title: Tooling: faster partial-swap SharedPoint verify digests and __init__ construction with identical receipts
head: 1baf7a8bc296cdb28bbb5572ed3937052a239244
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`, the partial-swap fork (`scripts/partial_swap/shared.py`) spends substantial wall time in two places on the historical `h=46` circuit:

1. `SharedPointCircuit.verify` — per-node / per-output `json.dumps` while building `circuit_sha256`
2. `SharedPointCircuit.__init__` — per-common sort/unpack/lookup in the merge/lookup loop

This PR applies the same byte-identical hand-rolled digest formatter used on the canonical producer in [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1994](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1994), then ports the merge/lookup construction rewrite from [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2054](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2054) onto this distinct producer fork (including `point_order` / sorted `pair_ids`). Support checks stay; `circuit_sha256` and the constructed DAG stay fieldwise identical. `certificates/partial-swap-network.json` updates only the `scripts/partial_swap/shared.py` `source_sha256` pin **once** for the combined file.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 (Linux-6.12.94+-x86_64-with-glibc2.39), five alternating fresh-process pairs:

| Path | Median before → after |
|---|---|
| `partial_swap.shared.SharedPointCircuit(46).verify` | **2.176 → 1.050 s (2.07×)** |
| `partial_swap.shared.SharedPointCircuit(46)` construction | **0.771 → 0.523 s (1.47×)** |

Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate.

Packages: `research/partial-swap-digest/`, `research/partial-swap-init/`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/partial-swap-digest/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/partial-swap-digest/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/partial-swap-digest
python3.12 -I -B research/partial-swap-init/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/partial-swap-init/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/partial-swap-init
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_PARTIAL_SWAP_DIGEST verify_cases=5 encoding_cases=8 certs=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/partial-swap-digest outcome=completed
PASS_PARTIAL_SWAP_INIT verify_cases=5 mutant=rejected certs=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/partial-swap-init outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only aside from the already-committed pin-only certificate refresh. Historical support checks use `assert` and are stripped under `-O`; structure/`circuit_sha256` identity remain the gates. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for these isolated historical-checker changes.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different objects): [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1793](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1793), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1861](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1861), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1922](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1922), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1984](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1984), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1994](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1994), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2054](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2054) (canonical `__init__`; this ports the same construction rewrite to the producer fork). [#2001](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2001)'s ExclusionCircuit / DisjointTensor support-mask files are not touched.
